p.i: Ad nos vix tenuis fama perlabitur aura.

main_text.p: Et quo pacto poterant {g}uxores1.Pet.3.6. fidelium obedien-tiam Sarae, aut {h}fidelesRom.4.12. cuncti Abrahami vestigia sequenda sibi proponere, & {i}ProphetasIac.5.10. sumere pro lenitatis exemplari; quae magno cum honore Sarae, Abrahami, atque Prophetarum praescri-bit Spiritus sanctus: quum innumerabiles non modo foeminae, sed & viri, Pontificiorum pastorum, vel luporum potius, saevitia sic e Scriptura-rum pascuis profligati sint, ut mirum sit, si non quod genus hominum Prophetae essent, aut ecquis Abrahamus, ecqua Sara fuisset unquam? Legere vero scripta cuiusquam Apostoli, aut Evange-listae, vulgo interdictum est sub gravi poena, in-star{k}Iof.6.21. & 7.12. anathematis: opinor, quo justius a novis Pharisæis, quam a veteribus, dici posset {l}Tur-Ioh.7.49.

page.notes: Marginal notes a to l are printed on the left margin and placed at their reference marks in the text. The reference marks in the text are printed as superscript letters; their positions were read from the scan and may be slightly off. The word "Ec-clesia" is split across lines with a printed hyphen. The line "ver-sum," is continued from the line before, and the verse line "Ad nos vix..." stands alone. The running head reads "ido lolatria" with a printed gap, given here as "idololatria". Final word "Tur-" is a line-end break; the catchword "ba" is at the right foot.
